name: Tokenbar
author: ishesatoshi
description: Token usage and estimated cost for every coding agent on the machine, read straight from their local logs. The bar shows today's spend; the panel has a full dashboard with ranges, charts, per-agent and per-model detail.

barWidget.description: Today's AI token usage and estimated cost, with a dashboard for every agent, model, and day.

schema.label: Bar readout
schema.description: What the bar shows: estimated spend, token count, or both.

schema.label: Bar range
schema.description: Which window the bar readout covers.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the scanner reads the logs. It only reads what was appended since the last run.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: Draw the chart glyph beside the value.
